facts.business: AGI Greenpac Limited manufactures container glass, specialty glass, and aluminium beverage cans for the packaging industry.

capacity_or_capex.item: Greenfield container glass facility at Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh

guidance_or_targets.statement: Gwalior facility will add 500 tonnes per day of container glass production
Gwalior facility will increase overall capacity by ~25%

key_risks: Volatility in fuel and raw material prices
Disruptions to global trade and energy supplies
Evolving consumer preferences and tighter regulation
facts.related_party_note: During the FY 2025-26 the Company has not provided any loans or advances in the nature of loans to firms/companies in which Directors are interested.
